english.title: Buyer of a horse fail to notify passport issuing organisation of ownership within 30 days
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the buyer of a horse, namely **(..SPECIFY HORSE..), failed to notify the transaction to the passport issuing organisation for registration of the new ownership within 30 days and include your name and address and the identification of the horse
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4(2) and (4) and 22 of the Horse Passports Regulations 2009.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
